title: PUMA: Post-Hoc Sparsification of Universal Multimodal Embeddings for Efficient Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.25780v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Universal multimodal embedders enable retrieval across text, image, and combined queries, but their dense representations incur high memory and inference costs. Post-hoc sparsification could reduce these costs but remains underexplored for multimodal retrieval. We introduce PUMA, a sparse autoencoder recipe that maps universal multimodal embeddings to compact sparse codes without retraining the backbone: a pretraining stage preserves dense dot-product geometry, after which the sparse encoder is fine-tuned for retrieval. We evaluate on five benchmarks covering text-to-image and composed image retrieval. On Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, PUMA is statistically indistinguishable from or improves over dense retrieval on four of five datasets. We further identify two failure modes of post-hoc sparsification: insufficient pre-TopK support and retrieval-misaligned active support. translated_title: PUMA：通用多模态嵌入的后验稀疏化以实现高效检索
translated_abstract: 通用多模态嵌入器支持跨文本、图像和组合查询的检索，但其稠密表示会导致高昂的内存和推理成本。后验稀疏化可以降低这些成本，但在多模态检索中尚未得到充分探索。我们引入了PUMA，一种稀疏自编码器方法，可将通用多模态嵌入映射为紧凑的稀疏编码，而无需重新训练骨干网络：预训练阶段保留稠密点积几何结构，随后对稀疏编码器进行检索微调。我们在五个基准上进行了评估，涵盖文本到图像和组合图像检索。在Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B上，PUMA在五个数据集中的四个上与稠密检索在统计上无显著差异或表现更优。我们还识别了后验稀疏化的两种失败模式：TopK前支持不足和检索不对齐的活动支持。PUMA将向量存储减少了8-16倍（FP32），并且比稠密检索快最多25倍。
tldr: PUMA通过稀疏自编码器将通用多模态嵌入后验稀疏化，无需重训骨干网络，在保持或提升检索性能的同时，将存储减少8-16倍并提速25倍。
en_tdlr: PUMA post-hoc sparsifies universal multimodal embeddings via a sparse autoencoder without retraining the backbone, reducing storage by 8-16x and speeding up retrieval by up to 25x while maintaining or improving performance.
